queue.title: Vanguard Sees 'Huge Rotation' by US Investors Into Bonds
queue.resumo: Ursula Marchioni, Vanguard's Europe head of multi-asset and adviser solutions, discusses the bond market and how we are witnessing "redesign of fixed income benchmarks in portfolios." She also discusses the differences between US and European investors, saying that in the US there is "huge diversification and huge rotation" out of equities and into fixed income, but in Europe it is still an "untapped opportunity." Marchioni speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
